Delhi-NCR Weather Forecast: Possibility of Sudden Heavy Rainfall

The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast the possibility of sudden heavy rainfall in Delhi-NCR on September 19. Areas including New Delhi, Noida, Gurugram, Ghaziabad, and Faridabad may experience this weather event. Separately, gold and silver prices for September 19 were released for various cities including Delhi, Mumbai, and Kolkata.
